NPKL.name: Nadaprabhu Kempegowda Layout (west)
NPKL.ask: 96 past BDA auction results here cleared at a median Rs 11,241/ft² (middle half Rs 9,441-13,146). Portal listings read lower (~Rs 6,500-8,300/ft², Housing.com/99acres), so treat these as provisional. BDA base is Rs 80,000/m² (~Rs 7,430/ft²).
NPKL.story: BDA's large new layout on the western fringe — Kommaghatta, Bheemanakuppe, Sulikere, Kannalli, Kodigehalli and nearby villages off Mysore Road and the NICE Road, near Kengeri. Formed in the 2020s and still developing: trunk roads and services are going in, titles are clean, and prices are appreciating fast on a low base, but amenities and resale depth lag the established South/West layouts. Market figures here are provisional until NPKL's own sales give firmer comps.
drivers: Mysore Road + Kengeri (Purple Line metro terminus / Challaghatta depot)
NICE Road access to ORR and the south
Large contiguous BDA layout with clean titles
watch: Far west — village-level amenities still maturing
Thin resale history, so price discovery is early
Infrastructure and lake-buffer timelines vary by block
Provisional market model — not yet re-based on NPKL sales

calibration.note: Likely winning bids come from a model trained on real final bids from BDA auctions T-08 and T-11 (bdaeauction.in archive).
